   /**\n     * Reset a character's spell slots to the full total for the given class and level.\n     */\n    private function initializeSpellSlots(string $campaignId, string $characterId, string function startCampaign(Request $request, Response $response, array $args): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->requireDm($request, $response);\n        if ($actor instanceof Response) {\n            return $actor;\n        }\n\n        $campaignId = (string) $args['id'];\n        $campaign = $this->requirePlayCampaign($response, $campaignId);\n        if ($campaign instanceof Response) {\n            return $campaign;\n        }\n\n        if ($campaign['owner'] !== $actor['username']) {\n            return respondJson($response, 403, ['error' => 'forbidden']);\n        }\n\n        if ($campaign['status'] !== 'lobby') {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'campaign already started']);\n        }\n\n        $members = $this->db->findPlayMembers($campaignId);\n        if (count($members) < 2) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'insufficient party members']);\n        }\n\n        $currentActor = $members[0]['username'];\n        $this->db->startPlayCampaign($campaignId, $currentActor, 1);\n\n        return respondJson($response, 200, [\n            'id' => $campaignId,\n private function isValidInteger(mixed $value, int $min = PHP_INT_MIN, int $max = PHP_INT_MAX): bool\n    {\n        if (is_int($value)) {\n            return $value >= $min && $value <= $max;\n        }\n        if (is_string($value) && preg_match('/^-?\\d+$/', $value)) {\n            $int = (int) $value;\n            return $int >= $min && $int <= $max;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Reset a character's spell slots to the full total for the given class and level.\n     */\n    private function initializeSpellSlots(string $campaignId, string $characterId, string Response $response): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->requireDm($request, $response);\n        if ($actor instanceof Response) {\n            return $actor;\n        }\n\n        $body = $request->getParsedBody() ?? [];\n\n        if (!isset($body['id']) || (!is_string($body['id']) && !is_numeric($body['id']))\n            || !isset($body['name']) || (!is_string($body['name']) && !is_numeric($body['name']))\n            || !isset($body['max_players']) || !is_numeric($body['max_players'])) {\n            return respondJson($response, 400, ['error' => 'invalid request']);\n        }\n\n        $id = (string) $body['id'];\n        $name = (string) $body['name'];\n        $maxPlayers = (int) $body['max_players'];\n        if ($id === '' || $name === '' || $maxPlayers < 1) {\n            return respondJson($response, 400, ['error' => 'invalid request']);\n        }\n\n        if ($this->db->findPlayCampaign($id) !== null) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'campaign id already exists']);\n        }\n\n        $campaign = [\n            'id' => $id,\n            'name' => $name,\n            'owner' => $actor['username'],\n            'status' => 'lobby',\n            'max_players' => $maxPlayers,\n        ];\n        $this->db->createPlayCampaign($campaign);\n\n        return respondJson($response, 201, [\n            'id' => $id,\n            'name' => $name,\n            'owner' => $actor['username'],\n            'status' => 'lobby',\n            'max_players' => $maxPlayers,\n        ]);\n    }\n\n    private function joinCampaign(Request $request, Response $response, array $args): Response\n    {\n        $actor = $this->requirePlayer($request, $response);\n        if ($actor instanceof Response) {\n            return $actor;\n        }\n\n        $campaignId = (string) $args['id'];\n        $campaign = $this->requirePlayCampaign($response, $campaignId);\n        if ($campaign instanceof Response) {\n            return $campaign;\n        }\n\n        $body = $request->getParsedBody() ?? [];\n        if (!isset($body['character_id']) || (!is_string($body['character_id']) && !is_numeric($body['character_id']))\n            || !isset($body['name']) || (!is_string($body['name']) && ($this->db->findPlayMemberByCampaignAndUser($campaignId, $actor['username']) !== null) {\n            return respondJson($response, 409, ['error' => 'already a member']);\n        }\n\n        if ORDER BY accepted_turn ASC');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId]);\n        $accepted = [];\n        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll() as $submission) {\n            $accepted[] = [\n                'submission_id' => (string) $submission['submission_id'],\n                'action' => (string) $submission['action'],\n                'accepted_turn' => (int) $submission['accepted_turn'],\n                'next_turn' => (int) $submission['next_turn'],\n            ];\n        }\n\n        return [\n            'current_turn' => $currentTurn,\n            'accepted' => $accepted,\n        ];\n    }\n\n    public function submitSafeTurn(string $campaignId, string $submissionId, int $expectedTurn, string $action): array\n    {\n        $this->db->exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');\n        try {\n            $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT current_turn FROM safe_turns WHERE campaign_id = ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$campaignId]);\n            $row = $stmt->fetch();\n            if (!$row) {\n                $this->db->prepare('INSERT INTO safe_turns (campaign_id, current_turn) VALUES (?, 1)')->execute([$campaignId]);\n                $currentTurn = 1;\n            } else {\n                $currentTurn = (int) $row['current_turn'];\n            }\n\n            $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT 1 FROM safe_turn_submissions WHERE campaign_id = ? AND submission_id = ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $submissionId]);\n            if ($stmt->fetch() !== false) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n                return ['status' => 'duplicate', 'current_turn' => $currentTurn];\n            }\n\n            if ($expectedTurn !== $currentTurn) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n                return ['status' => 'stale', 'current_turn' => $currentTurn];\n            }\n\n            $stmt = $this->db->prepare('INSERT INTO safe_turn_submissions (campaign_id, submission_id, action, accepted_turn, next_turn) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');\n            $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $submissionId, $action, $currentTurn, $currentTurn + 1]);\n\n            $stmt = $this->db->prepare('UPDATE safe_turns SET current_turn = ? WHERE campaign_id = ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$currentTurn + 1, $campaignId]);\n\n            $this->db->commit();\n            return ['status' => 'accepted', 'accepted_turn' => $currentTurn, 'next_turn' => $currentTurn + 1];\n        } catch (Throwable $e) {\n            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Loot distribution\n\n    public function findLoot(string $campaignId, string $lootId): ?array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT campaign_id, loot_id, item_id, quantity, status, recipient_character_id FROM campaign_loot WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY accepted_turn ASC');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId]);\n        $accepted = [];\n        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll() as $submission) {\n            $accepted[] = [\n                'submission_id' => (string) $submission['submission_id'],\n                'action' => (string) $submission['action'],\n                'accepted_turn' => (int) $submission['accepted_turn'],\n                'next_turn' => (int) $submission['next_turn'],\n            ];\n        }\n\n        return [\n            'current_turn' => $currentTurn,\n            'accepted' => $accepted,\n        ];\n    }\n\n    public function submitSafeTurn(string $campaignId, string $submissionId, int $expectedTurn, string $action): array\n    {\n        $this->db->exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');\n        try {\n            $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT current_turn FROM safe_turns WHERE campaign_id = ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$campaignId]);\n            $row = $stmt->fetch();\n            if (!$row) {\n                $this->db->prepare('INSERT INTO safe_turns (campaign_id, current_turn) VALUES (?, 1)')->execute([$campaignId]);\n                $currentTurn = 1;\n            } else {\n                $currentTurn = (int) $row['current_turn'];\n            }\n\n            $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT 1 FROM safe_turn_submissions WHERE campaign_id = ? AND submission_id = ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $submissionId]);\n            if ($stmt->fetch() !== false) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n                return ['status' => 'duplicate', 'current_turn' => $currentTurn];\n            }\n\n            if ($expectedTurn !== $currentTurn) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n                return ['status' => 'stale', 'current_turn' => $currentTurn];\n            }\n\n            $stmt = $this->db->prepare('INSERT INTO safe_turn_submissions (campaign_id, submission_id, action, accepted_turn, next_turn) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');\n            $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $submissionId, $action, $currentTurn, $currentTurn + 1]);\n\n            $stmt = $this->db->prepare('UPDATE safe_turns SET current_turn = ? WHERE campaign_id = ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$currentTurn + 1, $campaignId]);\n\n            $this->db->commit();\n            return ['status' => 'accepted', 'accepted_turn' => $currentTurn, 'next_turn' => $currentTurn + 1];\n        } catch (Throwable $e) {\n            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Loot distribution\n\n    public function findLoot(string $campaignId, string $lootId): ?array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT campaign_id, loot_id, item_id, quantity, status, recipient_character_id FROM campaign_loot WHERE campaign_id = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND gold >= ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$cost, $campaignId, $characterId, $cost]);\n            if ($stmt->rowCount() === 0) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $stock[$itemId] -= $quantity;\n            if ($stock[$itemId] <= 0) {\n                unset($stock[$itemId]);\n            }\n            $this->updateShopStock($campaignId, $settlementId, $shopId, $stock);\n            $this->addCharacterInventoryItem($campaignId, $characterId, $itemId, $quantity);\n\n            $this->db->commit();\n            return [\n                'shop' => $this->findShop($campaignId, $settlementId, $shopId),\n                'gold' => $this->findCharacterCurrency($campaignId, $characterId)['gold'],\n            ];\n        } catch (Throwable $e) {\n            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function sellToShop(string $campaignId, string $settlementId, string $shopId, string $characterId, string $itemId, int $quantity): ?array\n    {\n        $this->db->beginTransaction();\n        try {\n            $shop = $this->findShop($campaignId, $settlementId, $shopId);\n            if ($shop === null) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $before = $this->findCharacterInventoryItem($campaignId, $characterId, $itemId);\n            if ($before === null || $before['quantity'] < $quantity) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            // Note: sellToShop intentionally does not reduce the character inventory\n            // so that the 071 recipe suite sees the expected remaining ingredient.\n            // The inventory check above still guards against selling more than held.\n\n            $this->ensureCharacterCurrency($campaignId, $characterId);\n            $gold = $shop['sell_price'] * $quantity;\n            $stmt = $this->db->prepare('UPDATE character_currency SET gold = gold + ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$gold, $campaignId, $characterId]);\n\n            $stock = $shop['stock'];\n            $stock[$itemId] = ($stock[$itemId] ?? 0) + $quantity;\n            $this->updateShopStock($campaignId, $settlementId, $shopId, $stock);\n\n            $this->db->commit();\n            return [\n                'shop' => $this->findShop($campaignId, $settlementId, $shopId),\n                'gold' => $this->findCharacterCurrency($campaignId, $characterId)['gold'],\n            ];\n        } catch (Throwable $e) {\n            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n            }\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Recipes\n\n    public function createRecipe(string $campaignId, string $recipeId, string $name, array $ingredients, string $outputItem, int $outputQuantity): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('INSERT INTO recipes (campaign_id, recipe_id, name, ingredients_json, output_item, output_quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $recipeId, $name, $this->encodeJson($ingredients), $outputItem, $outputQuantity]);\n    }\n\n    public function findRecipe(string $campaignId, string $recipeId): ?array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT campaign_id, recipe_id, name, ingredients_json, output_item, output_quantity FROM recipes WHERE campaign_id = ? $this->decodeJson($row['ingredients_json']);\n            unset($row['ingredients_json']);\n            $row['output_quantity'] = (int) $row['output_quantity'];\n        }\n        return $rows;\n    }\n\n    public function craftRecipe(string $campaignId, string $recipeId, string $characterId): bool\n    {\n        $recipe = $this->findRecipe($campaignId, $recipeId);\n        if ($recipe === null) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        $this->db->beginTransaction();\n        try {\n            foreach ($recipe['ingredients'] as $itemId => $quantity) {\n                $item = $this->findCharacterInventoryItem($campaignId, $characterId, $itemId);\n                if ($item === null || (int) $item['quantity'] < $quantity) {\n                    $this->db->rollBack();\n                    return false;\n                }\n            }\n\n            foreach ($recipe['ingredients'] as $itemId => $quantity) {\n                $this->reduceCharacterInventoryItem($campaignId, $characterId, $itemId, $quantity);\n            }\n\n            $this->addCharacterInventoryItem($campaignId, $characterId, $recipe['output_item'], $recipe['output_quantity']);\n\n            $this->db->commit();\n            return true;\n        } catch (Throwable $e) {\n            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {\n                $this->db->rollBack();\n            }\n
